decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch embedded in the core modular sensing platform, management is likely to continue justifying the invested development and documentation effort and treat any weaker demand as temporary.

This industrial input module sits squarely in the established automation range and the earlier dedicated presentation signals visible commitment, making withdrawal unlikely under escalation of commitment.

The solid state relay module complements the firm's control ecosystem and existing production architecture, so management would be inclined to persist rather than reverse course after investing in it.

Although more niche than the core modules, the server room monitoring kit still reuses the firm's hardware, firmware and documentation assets, so management would more likely retain it and attribute limited traction to a specialized market.
As a recent add-on module within the established building-block system, it benefits from fresh investment and low marginal support costs, which favors keeping it on the market for longer.

The remote access service supports the publicly stated expansion of charging and energy-management products, so its strategic visibility and recent commitment make discontinuation unlikely absent clear failure evidence.
